_about: The contract between the worker and Core for POST /v1/tasks/:taskId/notifications/canva-status (architecture programme 1.3, SPLIT_PLAN.md section 5, N4).
Callers: apps/worker/src/canva-draft-workflow.ts (reportOutcome, reportNotRunnable) and apps/worker/src/outbox-consumer.ts (the task.outcome handler).
apps/worker/test/canva-status-contract.test.ts checks that the worker sends exactly these request bodies and handles each of these answers;
apps/core/test/canva-status-contract.test.ts checks that Core gives exactly these answers to these bodies. Change both sides with this file.

notRunnable.detail: Dispatched without an automatic Canva job; nothing was generated or spent.

scopeMismatch.detail: Workflow task/client/tenant mismatch: the dispatched client or tenant differs from the task record.
